Here is a mind map for planning the school's open day:

```mermaid
mindmap
  root(("School<br/>Open Day"))
    Purpose & Goals
      Show the new wing
      Meet future parents
      Set date and hours
      Agree on a budget
    Rooms & Logistics
      Classroom tours
      Signs and maps
      Chairs, tables, screens
      Parking and access
      Power for the stands
    Programme
      Choir in the hall
      Science demos
      Children's corner
      Art exhibition
      Snacks and drinks
      Raffle
    People & Helpers
      Organising group
      Pupil guides
      Shift plan
      First aid cover
      Lost and found
    Promotion
      Letters home
      Local news page
      Banner at the gate
      Signs on the day
    Money
      Parent donations
      Stand fees
      Raffle tickets
      Expense list
      Reserve
    Inclusion
      Step-free routes
      Quiet room
      Translated flyers
      Seating for elders
      Sign language guide
    Follow-up
      Feedback cards
      Thank-you notes
      Photos for the website
      Lessons for next year
      Enrolment questions
```

The programme is the busiest branch; the rest is routine.
